meta.title: AI Email MCP Server Pricing — Free, Agent & Scale Plans
meta.description: Compare MCPEmails plans by included successful actions. Inboxes and API keys are unlimited; actions reset with your billing period.

hero.lead: Every workspace includes unlimited inboxes and API keys. Successful billable MCP calls use actions; failed calls and inbox_list are free. Actions reset with your billing period and work stops at the cap.

rows.soc2: SOC 2 Type II report on request

items.a: One successful billable MCP tools/call uses one action. Failed calls, provider outages, authentication errors, rate limits, dashboard actions, OAuth, API-key management, and inbox_list are free. Every plan includes unlimited inboxes and API keys.

items.q: What counts as an MCP call?
items.a: A successful billable JSON-RPC tool invocation against your /mcp endpoint uses one action. inbox_list, failed calls, provider outages, authentication errors, and rate-limited calls are free. We're a standard MCP server, so the same endpoint works with Claude, Cursor, VS Code, ChatGPT, Windsurf, n8n, Make, and any MCP-compatible client.

items.q: Is my email content stored anywhere?
items.a: The email your agent reads is never stored: bodies, subjects, attachments, and thread content are fetched live from your provider and returned directly to the agent, with nothing persisted between calls. We store your encrypted OAuth token or app password so we can authenticate future requests. The one exception is a message you ask us to schedule for later — we store it until it is sent, and keep a record afterwards for your history.

items.q: What's the difference between Agent and Scale?
items.a: Free includes 2,500 actions per billing period. Agent includes 50,000 actions, a 300 requests/minute ceiling, 90-day history, and email support. Scale includes 300,000 actions, a 1,000/minute ceiling, roles, audit log, 1-year history, and priority support. The dashboard shows your usage and reset date; calls stop at the cap with no automatic overage charge.

items.q: Can I change or cancel my plan?
items.a: Yes. Upgrade, downgrade, or cancel any time from the billing section of your dashboard. If you cancel a paid plan, you keep access until the end of your billing period, then drop to Free automatically with its 2,500-action allowance.

items.q: How does the annual discount work?
items.a: Paying annually saves about 17% versus monthly billing: Agent is $120/year and Scale is $490/year. You're charged once for 12 months upfront. If you cancel mid-year, we refund the unused whole months.

Gmail uses OAuth 2.0. Fastmail connects with an app password. iCloud, Yahoo, Zoho, and Yandex connect with an app-specific password, and any other mailbox works through the generic IMAP / SMTP connector.
If you're unsatisfied within 30 days of your first paid invoice, contact us for a full refund, no questions asked.

items.q: Can I self-host it instead of paying?
items.a: Yes. MCP Emails is open source under AGPL-3.0 and free to self-host. A docker-compose stack runs the same MCP server, with your mailbox credentials encrypted under a key only you hold. Self-host covers IMAP and SMTP mailboxes; Gmail and Outlook one-click OAuth, the dashboard, team features, and support stay on the paid plans.

ctaBand.title: Ready to give your agent an inbox?
ctaBand.sub: Start on Free: no credit card and 2,500 actions per billing period. Upgrade when you need a larger allowance, higher burst limits, or team features.
